_design: Teaches sinking-log exit timing. Player MUST land on the sinking log (it's the only way over the slime that comes after — slime is positioned exactly where the log would have been if it hadn't sunk). Late = sink into slime double-death. Holocron at apex of the off-log jump rewards perfect timing.

params.comment: land here, then jump within ~600ms or sink
on-log essence — pickup during the brief stand
max-line: only catchable from double-jump off sinking log apex
punishes late exit from sinking log
